mode: deterministic: temp ledgers, fake Listing Management GET/POST, fake Gmail, temp dashboards; no real POST, no real e-mail, no network

results.test: before the listing's 7-day due date -> no GET, no POST; its own next due date is recorded
first due Monday: fresh GET of the live keywords (source of truth)
cleaned with the existing rules: every relevant word kept, repeated entry removed, nothing added
cleaned != live -> ONE POST of the freshly cleaned value (sku/sub_source/site/backend_keywords only), then Live Verified
results.detail: [{'sku': 'WCE2E2PK', 'sub_source': '8', 'site': 'UK', 'backend_keywords': 'Wire Cage Pendant Light shade industrial lamp'}]

results.test: audit history records the GET value, cleaned value, POST attempt, verification and final live value
same weekly cycle re-run -> not due (no second GET/POST)
next Monday: fresh GET; cleaned == live -> NO POST, Live Verified (weekly recurrence)
routine re-verification does not move the monitoring start (first_verified_at unchanged)
pending row: not re-processed before 7 days after its last POST
pending row, due: fresh GET -> live still has duplicates -> cleaned differs -> POST (from this GET) -> still pending
next due week: fresh GET again and repeat (a 2nd POST, each POST preceded by a GET in the same run)
cleaned == live and it equals the previously proposed value -> NO POST, Live Verified ('proposed value is live')
verification date recorded and 7-day monitoring starts from it (listing becomes tracked)
every attempt is in the audit history (original submission, 2 POSTs, final no-POST verification)
user changed the keywords: cleaned from the NEW live value (their new words kept), old proposal never sent
rejected update -> Update Failed; next due week retried from a fresh GET (GET precedes each POST) -> Live Verified
read-back matches neither value -> Verification Failed (no verification date)
keywords changed between the GET and the POST -> not sent
optimization recorded -> no check / Amazon update until the next weekly cycle
next Monday: user's keywords cleaned, POSTed once, verified -> optimization completed, baseline set
streak reset: baseline week not counted, next week count 1, no alert
later pair of consecutive declines -> NEW alert
keyword check + clean-up also when performance improved (no alert involved)
one decline -> no alert; two consecutive -> alert (unchanged)
a listing that is not in the report scope is never read or updated
identity mismatch (account) -> Update Failed, no POST
dry run: GET + clean + validate, NO POST, status unchanged; the production run the same Monday still sends once
> 249 bytes -> warning only, not truncated; dropping/adding a word blocks the POST
weekly keyword rows show the ledger status per ASIN-SKU (two different ledgers)
displayed counts, removed words, attempts and submission id come from the ledger
production ledger / dataset / extract / TEST-mail record unchanged
